title: Class Imbalance and Batch Effects in LLM-Based Screening for Systematic Reviews

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3.2: "Two models were evaluated: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo ... and gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, accessed via the OpenAI API ... Calls were executed with temperature 0".

prompt.location: exact templates for the four conditions are in the supplementary artifact package (Hida et al. 2026a), not in the paper text
prompt.note: Common structure (task definition, eligibility criteria, screening instructions, JSON output) is described in Sec. 3.3.

claim.metric: recall / F2 for study inclusion, individual mode, review rsl 2
claim.location: Sec. 4.5: "GPT-5-mini reached a recall of 0.369 and F2 of 0.409" on rsl 2 (N = 1,527, Table 1); full values in Supplementary Material Part II

data.source: SESR-Eval (Huotala et al., 2025), five selected reviews listed in Table 1

notes: Soft gap: the prompt templates are only in the accompanying artifact package rather than the paper body; if that package is public the run is straightforward. Per-review numbers for GPT-5-mini are mostly in the supplement; only rsl 2 is quoted in the text.

resolution.plan: Take the exact GPT-5-mini prompt template for the individual-mode condition from the Zenodo artifact package (supplementary document, Sec. 5); fill it with each of the 1,527 rsl 2 titles/abstracts and the review's eligibility criteria from SESR-Eval (public); call gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 at temperature 0 (Sec. 3.2), parse the JSON include/exclude decision and compute recall and F2 vs 0.369 / 0.409.
resolution.approximation: none beyond run-to-run variability; gpt-5-mini may not honour the temperature setting
